auth_rule_token.description: The Auth Rule Token associated with the rule. If this is set to null, then the result was not associated with a customer-configured rule. This may happen in cases where a tokenization is declined or requires TFA due to a Lithic-configured security or compliance rule, for example.

result.description: The result associated with this rule

name.description: The name for the rule, if any was configured

explanation.description: A human-readable explanation outlining the motivation for the rule's result
